token.description: From `open.requested` or `openFile.pending`: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, claimed once.

FileMode.description: What the page may do with an open file.

oneOf.description: Read-only: the page reads, nothing more.
Writable: the page may also write files (and use git, in later versions).

ReadReason.description: Why an open file is read-only.

oneOf.description:
A secret place: a secret's name (`.env`, keys, …), `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, keychains, browsers' data, the
companion's own state, … — also when reached through a symlink.

A file that runs by itself (`~/.zshrc`, `~/.gitconfig`, launch agents, …) while the setting
`[files] executes = "read"` makes those read-only.
Not UTF-8 text: shown as `windows-1252`, never written.
The person cannot write the file (no write permission, or another owner).
The person asked for read-only (`devtab open --read-only`).

The file was replaced by another one, moved, or became a symlink since it was opened: read-only until a
person opens it again.

result.description:
`openFile.claim`: what the person opened — a file of its own (`kind: file`), or a file inside an added project,
which opens as that project's file with the project's class (`kind: project`).

oneOf.description: `openFile.claim` of a file outside the added projects.

column.description: The column to show, 0-based, in characters of the line; null when not asked.

displayPath.description: The canonical path, with `~/` for the home folder.

executes.description:
A file that runs by itself (`~/.zshrc`, launch agents, …): marked; each write has its own journal line and a
"before" copy.

line.description: The line to show, 0-based (`devtab open --line 12` gives 11); null when not asked.

oneOf.description: `openFile.claim` of a file inside an added project: read and write it with the project's methods.

result.title: Claimed

summary: Claims a token, once: the open file (its id, mode and marks), or the project's file it names.
